_note: This is the only real lesson file. For the Programmer on M7-P5: once it is promoted to content/tutorial/, retire content/tutorial/sensei-lessons.json and point GameScene.ts, lessons.ts and guide.test.ts here. The warning and guided Counter lines are copied word for word from it.
notes: DRAFT for M7-P6, revised after the M7-P13 review (PR #46). Session 1 (the tutorial, run 1) teaches only Move, the '!' warning, the guided Counter and Strike. The warning and guided Counter lines, plus 'slowdown'/'nudge', are copied exactly from content/tutorial/sensei-lessons.json. lesson-counter-hint-2 and -3 are fading follow-ups (fadingFollowUp: true) and don't count as new lessons. Bow is taught once, by the tutorial floor's tutorial-bow step, so there is no second Bow lesson at home (review S1). After session 1, at most one new lesson per session: Dash (2), Insights (3), Decorating (4). Perfect Counter, Block and Step-out have ignoresSessionLimit: true and show right away the first time they come up. Keys: id, order, trigger, screens, practice, success, retry, earliestSession, ignoresSessionLimit, fadingFollowUp, plus optional slowdown/nudge. One sentence per screen; button names match the UI. line-welcome-home is a plain greeting on the first return home, not a lesson. It has no practice room and doesn't count toward the session limit. {player} is the profile's display name.
speaker: sensei

lessons.trigger: First open of the game (before the tutorial floor)
screens: Tap where you want to go, or use the stick.
You punch all by yourself when you're close.
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.

lessons.trigger: First '!' and red circle seen (game slows for the guided Counter)
screens: Look! A red circle.
It's coming!
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.

lessons.trigger: During the slowdown, as the circle nears full; Counter button pulses
screens: Tap Counter... now!
lessons.practice: Tap COUNTER when Sensei says now.
lessons.nudge: Take your time. Tap the blue COUNTER button!

lessons.trigger: Second '!' seen (smaller slowdown or none, Counter still pulses)
screens: Wait for it... Counter!
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.

lessons.trigger: Third '!' seen (no slowdown; small pulse only)
screens: Counter!
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.

screens: Your STRIKE button is glowing.
Tap it for a big, strong hit.
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.

lessons.trigger: First return to the Home Dojo, right after the tutorial's door home (plain line, not a lesson; no practice room)
screens: Welcome home, {player}! I'm glad you're back.

lessons.trigger: First time two attacks will land together
screens: Too many circles? Dash away.
Tap DASH to zoom out of danger.
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.

screens: After a fight, you can pick one Insight.
It helps you until you go home.
lessons.success: Good choice. Which one did you pick?
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.

screens: You found something for your dojo!
Drag it to any spot you like.
lessons.success: Your dojo looks more like you now.
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.

lessons.trigger: First occurrence in play (shows right away): the first Perfect Counter without help
screens: Tap when the circle is almost full.
That is a Perfect Counter.
It fills your Focus fast!
lessons.practice: Counter when the circle is almost full.
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.

lessons.trigger: First occurrence in play (shows right away): the first Block (COUNTER pressed a little early)
screens: That was a Block. Good guarding!
Wait a tiny bit longer for Perfect.
lessons.practice: Wait a tiny bit, then tap COUNTER.
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.

lessons.trigger: First occurrence in play (shows right away): the player walks out of a red circle
screens: Smart! Stepping out works too.
lessons.practice: Walk out of the red circle.
lessons.retry: That's okay. Try again whenever you're ready.
